units.source_text: 查喀医生每天一定会来帮我诊视两三回。

en.t: Doctor Chak would always come two or three times a day to examine me.

units.source_text: 我最早看到的那只河童——一只被称作巴咯的渔夫，

en.t: The first kappa I had seen, a fisherman called Bag,

units.source_text: 约莫三天来看望我一次。

en.t: came to visit me about once every three days.

units.source_text: 河童对人类的了解，远远超过人类对他们的了解。

en.t: The kappa understood humans far better than humans understood them.

units.source_text: 我猜这可能是因为河童捕获的人类比人类捕获的河童多得多的缘故。

en.t: I suppose this may have been because the kappa had captured far more humans than humans had captured kappa.

units.source_text: 也许说是捕获不是很准确，

en.t: Perhaps capture is not quite the right word,

units.source_text: 但在我来到河童国之前早有人类来过这里，

en.t: but before I came to the land of the kappa, humans had already been here,

units.source_text: 并且一生都住在河童国的也不在少数。

en.t: and quite a few had spent their whole lives in the kappa country.

units.source_text: 因为什么缘故呢？

en.t: For what reason?

units.source_text: 在这里，人类可以只靠自己不是河童而是人类这个特权就可以不劳而获度过一生。

en.t: Here, simply by enjoying the privilege of being human rather than kappa, a person could live an entire life without working.

units.source_text: 听巴咯说，以前有个年轻的修路工人偶然到了河童国，

en.t: According to Bag, a young road worker once happened to arrive in the kappa country,

units.source_text: 并且娶了雌河童当妻子，终老在此。

en.t: married a female kappa, and lived out the rest of his life there.

units.source_text: 据说这个雌河童不但是本国第一美女，

en.t: It is said that this female kappa was not only the greatest beauty in the country,

units.source_text: 她哄弄修路工人丈夫的手段也分外厉害。

en.t: but was also exceptionally skilled at coaxing and managing her road worker husband.

units.source_text: 大概过了一星期，依据河童国法律，

en.t: After about a week, under the laws of the kappa country,

units.source_text: 我这个人类身为“特别保护民”，被安排住在了查喀医生家的隔壁。

en.t: I, being human, was assigned lodging next door to Doctor Chak as a specially protected resident.

units.source_text: 给我安排的房子虽然不大，

en.t: The house arranged for me was not large,

units.source_text: 但是房子装修的很精致。

en.t: but its interior was very finely finished.

units.source_text: 而且，河童国和人类国家的文明程度没什么差别——至少跟日本差不多。

en.t: Moreover, there was little difference between the civilization of the kappa country and that of human nations, at least it was much like Japan.

units.source_text: 客厅在临街的一面，角落里摆放着一架小小的钢琴。

en.t: The parlor faced the street, and a small piano stood in one corner.

units.source_text: 墙上挂着一幅蚀刻类似的东西，

en.t: On the wall hung something like an etching,

units.source_text: 并且镶了镜框。

en.t: and it was set in a frame.

units.source_text: 可是，这房子面积大小、桌椅尺寸，都是以河童的身材比例定制的，

en.t: However, the size of the house and the dimensions of the tables and chairs were all made to the proportions of kappa bodies,

units.source_text: 我在里面就像进了儿童房。

en.t: so when I was inside, it felt as if I had entered a child's room.

units.source_text: 这是唯一让我觉得不方便的地方。

en.t: That was the only thing I found inconvenient.
